name: skill-creator
title_zh: 一键安装、创建、更新任何 Agent Skill
tagline_zh: 看到好 skill 想装却不会装？从零写 skill 又怕格式错？这个工具把安装、创建、重构全包了，你只管说需求。
tagline_en: Tired of manual skill installs or broken formats? This tool handles install, create, and restructure — just say.
desc_en: Create, install, or update skills in the workspace. Use when (1) installing a skill from a URL or remote source, (2) creating a new skill from scratch, (3) updating or restructuring existing skills. Always use this skill for any skill installation or creation task.
why_zh: 它把 skill 生命周期收成一条命令：远程 URL 直接装，本地从零建，旧 skill 自动重构。
why_en: It collapses the whole skill lifecycle into one command: install from URL, scaffold from scratch, or restructure existing ones.
limit_zh: 只作用于当前工作区的 skill 目录，不处理全局安装；从 URL 安装时要求目标仓库结构符合 CowAgent 约定。
limit_en: Only manages skills in the current workspace, not global installs. URL installs require the target repo to follow CowAgent conventions; otherwise it.
